typeBlock.description: This GDDI type is used to carry a space vehicle command that is requested to be uplinked. The command is pre-formatted for the vehicle and is carried in the GDDI payload with corresponding metadata. These messages are typically transferred from a C2 system to a FEP application for uplink Block-Commanding, as opposed to CCSDS-Commanding where the 'CCSDS MAP SDU' type would be used for CCSDS Space Packets, or the 'CCSDS Telecommand Frame' type would be used for CCSDS TC Frames.

tlv.description: Length in bits of the command data block. (Default: 0)
Identifier used to match command requests and command echoes. (Default: 0)
Type of encoding representing the command data: (0: Binary, 1: Dibit, 2: Tribit). (Default: 0)
The number of milliseconds or S-tones to be inserted between commands by the receiving uplink transmitter. Only applicable when 'Timestamp Seconds' is zero. (Default: 0)

The time that this command is to be released by the uplink transmitter, also known as Earliest Radiation Time (ERT). This represents the number of non-leap seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. Use a value of zero to send the command immediately. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
